brief:
Palestinian families have returned to their homes in Hebron following the end of an Israeli siege on the city, Al Jazeera English reported. The siege had prevented residents from accessing essential supplies and services, according to the report.

The return marks a shift in the military restrictions that had confined Palestinians to their homes. Details of the siege's duration and the circumstances that led to its lifting were not specified in the initial report.
dek: Palestinian families return home after Israeli siege of Hebron…
title: Palestinian families return to Hebron after Israeli siege ends
